title: Dieu gard de mal de deshonneur (Mouton)
desc: Jean Mouton, Dieu gard de mal de deshonneur. 3 voices (Superius, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
